scope.boundary_rule: Occurrence, publication/public-available, collection, and evidence-horizon times remain distinct. Existing events are updated rather than duplicated when later evidence changes status.

new_events.summary: IRGC said it destroyed another U.S. MQ-9 over Qeshm Island at 10:12 Iran time using a new advanced air-defense system within the integrated air-defense network, calling it the 53rd MQ-9 destroyed in the conflict. No U.S. or independent confirmation was found by the evidence horizon.

Saudi civil defense said falling debris from an intercepted Houthi drone in Taif province killed one Yemeni and injured a Saudi citizen and a Pakistani national, with vehicle and building damage reported.

new_events.actor: UN Fact-Finding Mission / United States / Iran
new_events.summary: A UN fact-finding mission reported reasonable grounds to believe U.S. February strikes in Iran included war crimes and that Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity in their response to anti-government protests. Preserve these as findings of the UN mission, not judicial determinations.

existing_event_updates.summary: Reuters reported preliminary Kpler data showing only three commercial/commodity vessel transits Wednesday, down from 12 Tuesday and below a 10-day average of 17. One Supramax entered via the Iranian route; a petroleum-product tanker entered and a Panamax tanker exited using dark routes. AIS-off traffic remains an explicit undercount risk.
Kpler data reported by Reuters showed 21 Bab el-Mandeb crossings Wednesday, down from 24 Tuesday. The chokepoint remains operational despite Houthi territorial gains and threats.

Oil prices fell materially Thursday amid reduced Saudi-Houthi attack intensity and market expectations of possible de-escalation; reported Brent was around $101.68 and WTI around $99.36 during the session. This is market reaction, not evidence that physical chokepoint or pipeline constraints have normalized.

claims_and_corrections.claim: IRGC said the Qeshm shootdown was the 53rd U.S. MQ-9 destroyed in the conflict.
Houthis claimed they shot down a Saudi F-15 over Marib.
claims_and_corrections.adjudication: REMAINS_UNVERIFIED_BY_EVIDENCE_HORIZON; AP Sep 17 reporting repeats claim without independent confirmation

diplomatic_updates.summary: Chinese reporting/readouts continued to frame the June interim agreement as a basis for rebuilding negotiations while separately urging effective measures to reopen Hormuz early. This supports coding Beijing's position as negotiation-restoration plus chokepoint reopening, not as established endorsement of Iran's demand for literal U.S. restoration of every prior MoU concession.

limitations: No direct paid Kpler/Vortexa/MarineTraffic terminal access
No U.S. confirmation located for the Sep 17 IRGC MQ-9 claim by evidence horizon
Search results for some source classes were sparse; absence of a new public report is not evidence of no activity
